comments.content: Bypassing the middleware entirely also bypasses its panic-recovery behavior, which the existing panic-handling tests rely on. A panic while serving either probe will therefore escape to net/http instead of receiving the framework's recovered response. Keep the recovery/writer path active and conditionally suppress only the normal request log.

Registering logging in a second `Use` call moves it after CORS and Metrics, whereas it was previously between Tracer and CORS. This means short-circuited CORS requests are no longer logged and panics from CORS/Metrics are outside logging's recovery path, even with the default configuration. Select `Logging` or `LoggingWithoutProbes` first, then register it in the original position in the same middleware chain.
